Title: Azure Security Center—New features announced at RSA 2018 now GA

Body.Content:
Azure Security Center released new features, now generally available, that will provide you with centralized visibility into the security state of your hybrid cloud workloads, and help you quickly take action. These new features include integration into the virtual machine experience and visibility into vulnerabilities in your web server settings. They make it simpler for you to get started and gain insight into your security posture quickly. The general availability of just-in-time virtual machine (VM) access allows you to restrict management ports to only be open when needed.

 

To learn more about all these new features and more, visit our announcement blog. To learn more about Azure Security Center, visit our webpage.
